definitions.explanation: Extremely sharp, with a finely honed edge or point. Used primarily for bladed objects like knives, swords, and tools. More formal and precise than the everyday word {鋭|するど}い.

examples.japanese: {鋭利|えいり}な⟦{刃物|はもの}→刃物：11752_hamono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful with sharp blades.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鋭利|えいり}な⟦{凶器|きょうき}→凶器：16384_kyouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: A sharp weapon was used in the crime.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鋭利|えいり}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い→取り扱い：09806_toriatsukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧{気|き}をつけて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: This kitchen knife is extremely sharp, so please handle it with great care.

notes:
Combines {鋭|えい} (sharp/keen) and ⟦{利|り}→利：29142_ri⟧ (advantage/sharpness), both reinforcing the idea of a fine, cutting edge. More formal and written than ⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧, and used almost exclusively for physical sharpness of bladed objects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鋭利|えいり}な⟦{刃物|はもの}→刃物：11752_hamono⟧: sharp blade/edged tool
- {鋭利|えいり}な⟦{凶器|きょうき}→凶器：16384_kyouki⟧: sharp weapon
- {鋭利|えいり}な⟦ナイフ→ナイフ：01039_naifu⟧: sharp knife
- {鋭利|えいり}な{刃先|はさき}: sharp cutting edge

USAGE:
Frequently appears in news reports and police descriptions when describing weapons or dangerous instruments. Unlike ⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧, which can describe eyes, observations, or pain, {鋭利|えいり} is almost always limited to the physical sharpness of cutting instruments.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧: sharp — the everyday adjective for sharpness; can be used figuratively (sharp eyes, sharp pain, sharp observation)
- ⟦{切|き}れ{味|あじ}→切れ味：19110_kireaji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧: cuts well — describes functional sharpness of a blade in practical terms
- ⟦{鈍|にぶ}い→鈍い：00315_nibui⟧: dull, blunt — the opposite of sharp
